title: The saved-value editor holds its modes in three useState values (saving, typed, saveError) plus refocus and opened-on refs
evidence: widget-src/src/components/MatrixSavedCells.tsx ValueCell (moved from BloodTestTimeline.tsx in PR 1456): saving, typed and saveError together encode closed, editing, saving and refused; refocusRef means refocus after close and openedOn holds the row the editor opened on. One union with a pure transition would hold them (H40 covers the blur timer refs beside them). Also: the PR 1456 pins (BloodTestTimeline.cells-pins.test.tsx) normalise ids with a pattern that also matches aria-invalid, so a flip of the editor's aria-invalid would not fail them; anchor it if the pins are reused
